description_en: Queries the operation logs of the data synchronization task for a specified ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询指定RDS实例数据同步链路的操作日志
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-replication-link-logs --db-instance-id pgm-bp1trqb4p1xd0000 --task-type create --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeReplicationLinkLogs

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You must set this parameter to the ID of the task that you create by calling the CreateReplicationLink operation for the disaster recovery instance
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID。调用CreateReplicationLink接口创建灾备实例时返回的任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task name. You must set this parameter to the name of the task that you create by calling the CreateReplicationLink operation for the disaster recovery instance
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。调用CreateReplicationLink接口创建灾备实例是的任务名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

create: creates a synchronization link.
create-dryrun: performs a precheck before a synchronization link is created.

Valid values:

create: creates a replication link.
create-dryrun: performs a precheck before a replication link is created
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。

parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

GmtCreated.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC

GmtModified.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in UTC

ReplicationInfo.description_en: The synchronization information. This parameter is a reserved parameter

ReplicationState.description_en:
The status of the synchronization. Valid values:

steaming: The synchronization is in progress.
finish: The synchronization is complete.
disconnect: The synchronization is disconnected
ReplicationState.description_zh:
同步状态。

steaming：同步中。
finish：完成。
disconnect：断开

ReplicatorAccount.description_en: The account of the database that is used for data synchronization
ReplicatorAccount.description_zh: 同步数据的数据库账号

SourceAddress.description_en: The endpoint of the source instance

SourceCategory.description_en:
The type of the source instance. Valid values:

other: other instances
aliyunRDS: an ApsaraDB RDS instance
SourceCategory.description_zh:
源实例类别。

other：其他。
aliyunRDS：阿里云 RDS 实例

SourcePort.description_en: The port number of the source instance

TaskStage.description_en:
The stage of the task. Valid values:

precheck: the precheck stage.
basebackup: the basic backup stage.
startup: the startup stage.
increment: the incremental synchronization stage
TaskStage.description_zh:
任务阶段。

precheck：预检查。
basebackup：基础备份。
startup：启动。
increment：增量同步

TaskStatus.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

success
failure
running
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。

success：成功。
failure：失败。
running：运行

TaskType.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

create: creates a synchronization link.
create-dryrun: performs a precheck before a synchronization link is created
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。
create：创建同步链路。
create-dryrun：创建同步链路预检查
